Objective: publish the single versioned Intent/Risk contract module with four NATS event schemas, AsyncAPI references, one-owner metadata, retry/DLQ/replay/redaction semantics, and flow coverage registration. Acceptance: telemetry.intent.detected.v1, telemetry.intent.deferred.v1, telemetry.risk.detected.v1, and risk.severity.ranked.v1 define correlation, causation, session scope, policy/model revision, evidence, and mode label; invalid versions, missing evidence, oversized payloads, and unsafe raw text are rejected by executable schema constraints; coverage and API traceability checks pass. Compact context: this is contract-only; no domain algorithms, persistence, runtime, UI/BFF, or external mutation. Pilot policy is simulated only: categories SPAM, TOXIC, SCAM, OFF_PLATFORM, COORDINATED_BOT; conservative severity precedence; risk-policy-pilot-v1 score bands; missing policy/language/redaction/ambiguous evidence/out-of-range scores are DEFERRED or REJECTED, never LOW/ignore. Architecture requires versioned JSON Schema/Ajv, NATS JetStream, durable commit before publish, server-authoritative session/tenant scope, idempotency, audit lineage, redaction, and fail-closed unknown outcomes. Flow authority requires event_id, event_type, occurred_at, live_session_id, correlation_id, causation_id, schema_version, producer, idempotency_key, policy_version, redacted_evidence_ids, propagation, and explicit rejected/deferred/unknown/reconciling outcomes.
